_comment: Lifeseed pools for The Oversight. Every character gets a lifeseed: a region anchor, named people, named places, events, skill origins, a wound, a want. Backstories, keepsakes, flashbacks, and motives all read from the SAME seed — that's the coherence guarantee. Region towns are real towns; fragments never cross regions.
